question: In the 56th meeting of Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) held in August 2025, after assessing the current and evolving macroeconomic situation, the MPC voted to maintain the policy repo rate at:
solution:
p>The correct answer is __**5.50%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **56th meeting** of the **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)** was conducted in **August 2025** to evaluate the **macroeconomic situation** and determine the course of India's monetary policy.
 
• After a comprehensive review of the prevailing **economic indicators**, the **MPC** decided to maintain the **policy repo rate** at **5.50%**.
 
• The decision to keep the **repo rate** unchanged reflects the committee's focus on maintaining a balance between **inflation control** and supporting **economic growth** momentum.
 
• By keeping the rate at **5.50%**, the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** aims to ensure that **retail inflation** remains within the target range while providing a stable environment for **investment** and **consumption**.
 
• The **MPC** also decided to remain focused on the **withdrawal of accommodation** to ensure that **inflation** progressively aligns with the target, while supporting **GDP growth**.
